description: React component for displaying and managing reactions on a post, including rendering existing reactions and an add reaction button.

classes.name: ReactionList
classes.description: React component for displaying a list of reactions on a post, allowing toggling reactions and adding new ones.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component state with an empty list of emoji names.

methods.name: getDerivedStateFromProps
methods.description: Updates the emojiNames state based on the reactions prop, adding new emoji names as they appear.

methods.name: handleEmojiClick
methods.description: Handles clicking on an emoji, toggling the reaction for the post.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the list of reactions and an add reaction button if permitted.
